q-102581.name: Question 3
q-102581.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14222660/assets/691ef4d815f6150b5940c323c5a2be09dc0f0ea1abdd3be36560d931fd1f5015.png)

The polygon $T$ is mapped to the polygon ${T}^{′}$ under the action of a reflection. What is the equation of the line of reflection?
q-102581.worked_solution:
The line of reflection is the perpendicular bisector of the segments joining each point to its image. 

Therefore, the equation of the line of reflection is $y=x,$ as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14222660/assets/d1278df44d05d0bb2169e72c1dce84650b0d4f269dd14d57c4d046f634e1ab7a.png)

q-102581.html:
Question 3
?

The polygon T is mapped to the polygon T′ under the action of a reflection. What is the equation of the line of reflection?

a
y=x
b
y=−x
c
y=x+1
d
y=0
e
x=0
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The line of reflection is the perpendicular bisector of the segments joining each point to its image.

Therefore, the equation of the line of reflection is y=x, as shown below.
